      Planning Tools i

      • Degree: B.S. in Computer Science
      • Destination: FIU – College of Engineering & Computing
      • Origin: Miami Dade College (Connect4Success)
      • Catalog: 2026–2027
      • Complete an Associate in Arts (AA) degree at MDC.
      • Minimum cumulative transfer GPA of 2.0.
      • Grade of "C" or higher in all prerequisites.
      • Pass prerequisites within two attempts; drops/withdrawals (W) count as attempts.
      • MAC 2311 (Calculus 1) must be completed before transfer.
      • Take math and science every term to stay on track.
      • Choose science courses that form a sequence totaling at least 8 credits with labs.
      • COP 2805C at MDC earns upper-division credit (FIU COP 3337).
      • Finish MAD 2104 and COP 2805C before completing your AA.

      Target Universities:

      Internships & Certs: Google STEP, Microsoft Explore, NSF REU, PCEP Python, AWS Cloud Practitioner, CompTIA Security+.

      Est. MDC Lower-Division Cost: ~$120/credit (in-state estimate).

      Est. Upper-Division (2 yrs): ~$13,000 in-state public (FIU/UF/FSU/UCF) • ~$66k–$124k out-of-state/private (GT/MIT/UM). All figures are estimates.
